CONTROLS.NAME: shimmer
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a colorful shimmer through the fluid. Careful, too much shimmering can kill the simulation.

CONTROLS.NAME: shock
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a vertical shock through the fluid, pulsing the color as well. Careful, too many shocks can kill it.

CONTROLS.NAME: reset_center
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Feeds the center of the scene. Push if your simulation dies, or the screen is all black.

CONTROLS.NAME: bpm_oscillate
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change the motion of the fluid. When OFF, it will be more constant. When ON it will move back and forth with the BPM of the song.

CONTROLS.NAME: media_color
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Media MUST BE SELECTED to see effects. Changes the paint color of the user selected texture.

CONTROLS.NAME: tunnel
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Bottom Left is OFF. Moving this causes a 'tunneling' effect. Can be great with bpm oscillate ON.

CONTROLS.NAME: pyramid
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Apply some triangularly arranged mirrors to the scene.
